model_facts.text: The 2.8 change raised the export timeout and did not touch lease renewal. Those are different clocks, which is why issue 902 is still open.
Release 3.2 requires both the lease heartbeat and the cancellation cleanup. Only one of the two is merged.
A cancelled export can leave a partial object in the destination bucket. Issue 903 is open.
Exports that resume were metered twice for rows before the resume point. The billing run is on hold and credit notes follow reconciliation.
Destination changes are not written to the audit log, and the webhook signing key is past its rotation date.

stories.summary: The lease heartbeat holds at Lumen's real volume, but cancellation cleanup is still open. The renewal depends on saying both out loud.
stories.title: A renewal that depends on an honest answer, again

stories.summary: Release 3.2 needs two fixes, not one. The last time only one landed, the release note said fixed and the bug stayed open for a year.
stories.title: Release 3.2 has a two-part gate

stories.summary: Metering counted resumed exports twice. Northstar found it before any customer did, put the billing run on hold, and told the affected accounts first.
stories.title: A billing fault the company found first

stories.summary: Two audit findings remain open before the November window. Both are scoped narrow on purpose so they land in weeks rather than months.
stories.title: Two findings and a November deadline

stories.summary: Nothing failed on 12 August; everything was late. The single preventing action is a pre-warmed worker floor, and it is not deployed yet.
stories.title: An outage where nothing broke

stories.summary: A renamed source column was dropped silently from a clinical data sync. The customer found it. The blast-radius report comes before the fix.
stories.title: Silent data loss in the worst place to have it

stories.summary: The Snowflake connector is blocked on a chunk writer that replays its last chunk on retry. Building on it first would build the bug into a new connector.
stories.title: A feature blocked by the right dependency

stories.summary: Staging access has taken up to nine days because nobody owned it. Somebody owns it now, and the next two starters are the test.
stories.title: The slowest step in onboarding finally has an owner
